facts.statement: Ghost Hunters in Snowhill, Stillwater Crossing and Bristlewood are world events for scaring off the Pumpkin Prince's ghosts.
facts.quote: Talk to the Ghost Hunters in Snowhill, Stillwater Crossing and Bristlewood to help scare them off.

article_summaries.title: First Annual Super Spooktacular
article_summaries.summary: SOE's official news post announcing Free Realms' Halloween event, the First Annual Super Spooktacular, running October 14 through November 11 (2009) and free to all registered players. It lists the event's costumes, Pixiewood decorations, trick-or-treating, Halloween quests, world events, a new Members battle instance, TCG quest packs and a daily prize wheel.
